howToPlay: Use the Super to isolate high-value targets in the Shadow Realm where you gain speed and reload buffs. Utilize the Poison Mushroom gadget to prevent enemies from attacking while landing your basic attacks. Manage terrain effectively using the Replanting gadget to close gaps or escape danger.
gears: Equip SPEED and DAMAGE to maximize lethality during aggressive engages. Use GADGET COOLDOWN to ensure the Poison Mushroom or Replanting gadgets are available more frequently.
trait: This brawler suits a calculated assassin who excels at isolating targets and controlling the flow of combat through specialized mechanics.
